## VIX (Volatility Index) term structure

The data is downloaded from the [Taiwan Futures Exchange](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/3/dlOptDailyMarketView). VIX for each expiration date is calculated, and a daily static term-structure chart is published. The methodology is based on Cboe VIX, see [Cboe Volatility Index Mathematics Methodology](https://cdn.cboe.com/resources/indices/Cboe_Volatility_Index_Mathematics_Methodology.pdf).

### Front-expiry VIX vs TAIEX

The nearest-expiry VIX is shown against the TAIEX close over the latest month, illustrating how short-dated implied volatility moves with the index.

::: {.column-page}

```{=html}
<div class="project-card">
  <p id="front-vix-taiex-status">
    Nearest-expiry VIX versus the TAIEX close over the latest 30 calendar days.
  </p>

  <img
    id="front-vix-taiex-chart"
    alt="TAIEX close and nearest-expiry TXO VIX-style implied volatility over the latest month"
    style="width:100%;"
  >
</div>
```

:::

## IV (Implied Volatility) Curves

IV is calculated by numerically inverting the Black formula for each eligible OTM option quote. The workflow uses settlement prices, requires exact option–futures expiration matching, and performs no nearest-contract substitution or IV smoothing.

### TAIEX Futures (TXF) IV curve

Only TXF futures contracts with matching expiration dates are included. The chart updates daily, displaying the four nearest expiration dates.

<div class="project-card">
  <p id="tx-status">Loading the latest TX curve…</p>
  <img id="tx-chart" alt="Latest TXO implied-volatility curve using same-expiry TX futures" style="width:100%; max-width:1100px;">
</div>

### Mini-TAIEX Futures (MXF) IV curve

Only MXF futures contracts with matching expiration dates are included. The chart updates daily, displaying the four nearest expiration dates.

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/plotly.js-dist-min@4.1.0/plotly.min.js"></script>

<script>
(() => {
  const user = "siang-dai";

  // 注意：這裡改成現在真正的 repo 名稱
  const repo = "txo-vix-iv";

  const stamp = Date.now();

  const rawRoot =
    `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${user}/${repo}/main`;

  const rawOutput = `${rawRoot}/output`;
  const rawData = `${rawRoot}/data`;

  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // VIX interactive term structure
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  const chart = document.getElementById("vix-term-chart");
  const status = document.getElementById("vix-status");
  const slider = document.getElementById("vix-date-slider");

  const startLabel = document.getElementById("vix-start-date");
  const selectedLabel = document.getElementById("vix-selected-date");
  const endLabel = document.getElementById("vix-end-date");

  function parseCsv(text) {
    const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
    const headers = lines[0].split(",");

    return lines
      .slice(1)
      .map(line => {
        const values = line.split(",");

        const row = Object.fromEntries(
          headers.map((header, i) => [
            header,
            values[i] ?? ""
          ])
        );

        return {
          Date: row.Date.trim(),
          Expiration_Month: row.Expiration_Month.trim(),
          Expiration_Date: row.Expiration_Date.trim(),
          Days_to_Exp: Number(row.Days_to_Exp),
          Forward: Number(row.Forward),
          VIX: Number(row.VIX)
        };
      })
      .filter(row =>
        row.Date &&
        Number.isFinite(row.Days_to_Exp) &&
        Number.isFinite(row.VIX)
      );
  }

  function isoDate(value) {
    return new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);
  }

  function renderTermStructure(rows, date) {

    const daily = rows
      .filter(row => row.Date === date)
      .sort((a, b) => a.Days_to_Exp - b.Days_to_Exp);

    const bodyColor =
      getComputedStyle(document.body).color;

    const trace = {
      type: "scatter",

      mode: "lines+markers",

      x: daily.map(row => row.Days_to_Exp),
      y: daily.map(row => row.VIX),

      // 保留給 hovertemplate 使用
      text: daily.map(row => row.Expiration_Month),

      customdata: daily.map(row => [
        row.Expiration_Date,
        row.Forward
      ]),

      hovertemplate:
        "<b>%{text}</b>" +
        "<br>Expiration: %{customdata[0]}" +
        "<br>Days to expiration: %{x:.0f}" +
        "<br>VIX-style IV: %{y:.2f}%" +
        "<br>Forward: %{customdata[1]:,.2f}" +
        "<extra></extra>",

      line: {
        width: 2.4
      },

      marker: {
        size: 8
      }
    };

    const layout = {

      title: {
        text:
          `TXO VIX Term Structure — ${date}`,
        x: 0.5
      },

      xaxis: {
        title: "Days to expiration",
        rangemode: "tozero",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.22)"
      },

      yaxis: {
        title: "Annualized implied volatility (%)",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.22)"
      },

      margin: {
        l: 70,
        r: 25,
        t: 70,
        b: 65
      },

      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",

      font: {
        color: bodyColor
      },

      hovermode: "closest",

      showlegend: false,

      autosize: true
    };

    Plotly.react(
      chart,
      [trace],
      layout,
      {
        responsive: true,
        displaylogo: false,
        scrollZoom: false
      }
    );

    selectedLabel.textContent = date;

    status.textContent =
      `Trading date: ${date} · ` +
      `${daily.length} expirations · ` +
      `move the slider to inspect the last 30 calendar days.`;
  }

  fetch(
    `${rawData}/vix_term_structure_history.csv?t=${stamp}`
  )
    .then(response => {

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("VIX history unavailable");
      }

      return response.text();
    })

    .then(text => {

      const rows = parseCsv(text);

      const allDates =
        [...new Set(rows.map(row => row.Date))]
          .sort();

      if (!allDates.length) {
        throw new Error("No VIX history rows");
      }

      // 最新有資料的交易日
      const latestDate =
        allDates[allDates.length - 1];

      // 最近 30 calendar days
      // 包含 latestDate，所以往前減 29 天
      const cutoff = isoDate(latestDate);

      cutoff.setUTCDate(
        cutoff.getUTCDate() - 29
      );

      // 只保留這 30 天內真正存在資料的交易日
      const recentDates =
        allDates.filter(
          date => isoDate(date) >= cutoff
        );

      slider.min = "0";
      slider.max =
        String(recentDates.length - 1);

      slider.step = "1";

      // 預設顯示最新一天
      slider.value =
        String(recentDates.length - 1);

      slider.disabled = false;

      startLabel.textContent =
        recentDates[0];

      endLabel.textContent =
        recentDates[recentDates.length - 1];

      function updateFromSlider() {

        const selectedDate =
          recentDates[
            Number(slider.value)
          ];

        renderTermStructure(
          rows,
          selectedDate
        );
      }

      // 拖曳時即時更新
      slider.addEventListener(
        "input",
        updateFromSlider
      );

      updateFromSlider();
    })

    .catch(error => {

      console.error(error);

      status.textContent =
        "Interactive history could not be loaded; " +
        "showing the latest static chart instead.";

      // fallback：如果 CSV 抓不到，
      // 還是顯示原本 PNG
      chart.innerHTML = `
        <img
          src="${rawOutput}/latest_term_structure.png?t=${stamp}"
          alt="Latest TXO VIX term structure"
          style="width:100%; max-width:960px;"
        >
      `;

      slider.disabled = true;
    });


  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // TX / MXF IV charts
  // 保持你原本的靜態圖功能
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  function setStaticChart(
    imageId,
    statusId,
    filename
  ) {

    const image =
      document.getElementById(imageId);

    const chartStatus =
      document.getElementById(statusId);

    image.src =
      `${rawOutput}/${filename}?t=${stamp}`;

    image.onerror = () => {

      chartStatus.textContent =
        "The chart is not available yet. " +
        "Run the repository workflow once.";
    };
  }

  setStaticChart(
    "tx-chart",
    "tx-status",
    "latest_tx_iv_calibration.png"
  );

  setStaticChart(
    "mtx-chart",
    "mtx-status",
    "latest_mtx_iv_calibration.png"
  );

  setStaticChart(
    "front-vix-taiex-chart",
    "front-vix-taiex-status",
    "latest_front_vix_vs_taiex.png"
  );


  fetch(
    `${rawOutput}/latest_iv.json?t=${stamp}`
  )
    .then(response => {

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          "IV metadata unavailable"
        );
      }

      return response.json();
    })

    .then(meta => {

      const tx = meta.products.TX;
      const mtx = meta.products.MTX;

      document.getElementById(
        "tx-status"
      ).textContent =
        `Latest trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} || ` +
        `${tx.plotted_points} OTM IV points || ` +
        `Generated in Taiwan: ${meta.generated_at_taipei}`;

      document.getElementById(
        "mtx-status"
      ).textContent =
        `Latest trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} || ` +
        `${mtx.plotted_points} OTM IV points || ` +
        `Generated in Taiwan: ${meta.generated_at_taipei}`;
    })

    .catch(() => {

      document.getElementById(
        "tx-status"
      ).textContent =
        "Latest automatically generated TX IV curve.";

      document.getElementById(
        "mtx-status"
      ).textContent =
        "Latest automatically generated MTX IV curve.";
    });

})();
</script>

For detailed contract specifications and expiration dates, please refer to the [TAIFEX Futures Specs](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/tX) and [TAIFEX Options Specs](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/tXO).
